The shading on the green character's legs lacks clear anatomical definition, appearing somewhat smudged or 'muddy' compared to the sharper lines on the upper body. This could be print degradation or AI artifacting.

The limbs of the figure in the background (top center) blend ambiguously into the background colors. It is difficult to distinguish where the arm ends and the background begins, suggesting slight fusion or structural ambiguity.
